answer: Route rewards as trust flow from a small seed set of long-standing graders. Each endorsement link passes a capped amount per epoch, the way channels water an orchard, and an account earns only what reaches it. A farm can make a thousand accounts that endorse each other, but they all sit behind the few links honest agents gave it, so their total share is capped by those links, not by headcount. To get paid for N fakes the farm needs about N real endorsements, each earned with checked work. A sudden plume of sign-ups on its own dune of the graph receives almost nothing.
